system.name: M2XFP
system.one_liner: a metadata-augmented microscaling data format with hardware co-design for accurate low-bit LLM quantization

components.name: Network on-chip
components.role: interconnect distributing data between off-chip memory and replicated M2XFP Core tiles

components.name: M2XFP Core
components.role: one of several replicated compute tiles integrating M2XFP quantization into a systolic dot-product pipeline

components.name: DMA
components.role: moves data between on-chip network and local core buffers

components.name: L1 cache
components.role: on-chip cache local to the core

components.name: Compute Engine
components.role: main systolic compute datapath, expanded in the zoomed detail panel

components.name: Vector Unit
components.role: handles vector/elementwise operations alongside the compute engine

components.name: Activation Buffer
components.role: buffers input activations feeding the dot product array

components.name: Weight Buffer
components.role: buffers weights feeding the dot product array

components.name: Top-1 Decode Unit
components.role: selects the dominant element per subgroup as part of M2XFP decoding

components.name: Dot Product Unit Array
components.role: array of MAC units performing the systolic dot-product computation

components.name: Quantization Engine
components.role: online-quantizes outputs into M2XFP format, containing an Encoding Unit and a Scaling & Normalize Unit

content.key_idea: M2XFP is integrated into a conventional systolic-array accelerator with lightweight modifications: a Top-1 Decode Unit and a Quantization Engine are added inline with the existing activation/weight buffers and dot-product array, without disrupting the systolic pipeline.

evidence: Fig. 9 illustrates the overall compute core, which integrates M2XFP into a conventional systolic array pipeline with lightweight modifications.

summary: M2XFP is a metadata-augmented microscaling quantization format with an accompanying hardware unit integrated into an LLM accelerator. This figure gives the architecture overview: off-chip DRAM and an on-chip network feed a stack of replicated M2XFP Core tiles, each with a Controller, DMA, L1 cache, Compute Engine and Vector Unit. A dashed callout zooms into one core's Compute Engine, showing Activation and Weight Buffers feeding a Dot Product Unit Array through a Top-1 Decode Unit, with results flowing to an Output Buffer and then a Quantization Engine (an Encoding Unit and Scaling & Normalize Unit) that re-quantizes outputs into M2XFP format. Light blue highlights the Compute Engine block, while blue tags mark the specific new units M2XFP adds to an otherwise conventional systolic dot-product pipeline.
summary_zh: 该图展示M2XFP整体架构：片外DRAM经片上网络连接多个M2XFP计算核心，缩放视图展示计算引擎内部——激活/权重缓冲经Top-1解码单元送入点积阵列，输出经量化引擎（编码单元与缩放归一化单元）重新量化为M2XFP格式。
